verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a SaaS that stores scanned mail and documents, so an AI-training data-use policy or opt-out is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack has no mention of AI training, model training opt-outs, or data-use restrictions. The documented privacy features, such as choosing not to have mail opened or scanned, 2FA, shredding and signing a HIPAA BAA, are adjacent controls and do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
